protocol.note: PIT MAE is scripts/_synthetic_probe.score through revised_eval.pit_mae (the frozen path); the per-mic tracks here are the same call's return value, so the recomputed mean over mics is asserted equal to pit()'s
protocol.decomposition: per frame the four tracks are SORTED; centre = mean over rotors, gaps = the three adjacent differences. centre_err = centre(pred) - centre(label); spread_err = the deviation from the centre, predicted minus label
